three_axes.learning_difficulty: Measured only after dataset acceptance. High scores permitted; no target/feature weakening to manufacture error.
three_axes.population_realism: Declared synthetic processes, coverage/overlap, operational feasibility and shortcut traceability; no empirical realism certification.
three_axes.predicate_correctness: Exact causal tests, schema and independent evaluator fixtures; any mismatch blocks generation.

trigger_policy: Any hidden field/future leakage, label inconsistency or unexplained deterministic origin signature blocks training. Strong legitimate component discrimination demands written scientific review, not automatic feature deletion or repeated generation. Archive the original diagnosis and authorize a new version only for a substantive reason.
